```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
#load library
library(b3gbi)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)

```

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" appearance="minimal" icon="false"}
{{< include ObservedSpeciesRichness.Rmd >}}

```{r, eval=FALSE}
#load library
library(b3gbi)


#Execute preprocessing step (TEST)
OSR_map <- obs_richness_map(Angiosperm_data_cube,
                            cell_size="grid")

OSR_ts <- obs_richness_ts(Angiosperm_data_cube, 
                          cell_size="grid")

plot_map(OSR_map,
         visible_gridlines = FALSE)

plot_ts(OSR_ts)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
OSR_map <- readRDS("./Flanders_1km/OSR_map.rds")$data

ggplot(data = OSR_map) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = diversity_val), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(na.value = NA) +
  theme_void()+
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())


```

The map below displays observed species richness in Flanders, but only where completeness is larger than 0.5. The regions which are not displayed, are undersampled.

```{r, echo = FALSE}
completeness_map <- readRDS("./Flanders_1km/ComP_map.rds")$data


threshold <- 0.5

# Assuming both datasets have the same geometry/order
OSR_masked <- OSR_map %>%
  left_join(
    completeness_map %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      select(cellCode, completeness=diversity_val),
    by = "cellCode"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diversity_val = ifelse(completeness >= threshold,
                           diversity_val,
                           NA)
  )

ggplot(data = OSR_masked) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = diversity_val), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(na.value = NA) +
  theme_void()+
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

```

```{r, eval=FALSE, echo = FALSE}
OSR_ts <- readRDS('./Flanders_1km/OSR_ts.rds')
plot_ts(OSR_ts,
        y_label ='Total observed species richness in Flanders',
        max_year=2022)
```
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" appearance="minimal" icon="false"}
{{< include TotalOccurrences.Rmd >}}

```{r, eval=FALSE}
#load library
library(b3gbi)

TO_map <- total_occ_map(Angiosperm_data_cube,
                            cell_size="grid")

TO_ts <- total_occ_ts(Angiosperm_data_cube, 
                          cell_size="grid")

plot_map(TO_map, 
         visible_gridlines = FALSE)

plot_ts(TO_ts)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
TO_map <- readRDS('./Flanders_1km/TO_map.rds')$data

ggplot(data = TO_map) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = diversity_val), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "D",
    values = c(0, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 1)
  )+
  theme_void()+
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )  


```

```{r, eval=FALSE, echo = FALSE}
TO_ts <- readRDS('./Flanders_1km/TO_ts.rds')
plot(TO_ts, y_label='Number of total occurrences in Flanders',max_year=2022)
```
:::
